skill_approaches.label: Haul the recoverable stores
skill_approaches.information: Trained hauling recovers the reported stores in one turn, with one provision upfront and a higher DC; failure completes no objective.

skill_approaches.label: Seek quiet access
skill_approaches.information: Attempt access without bargaining away supplies. This does not defeat the occupants or claim the site is cleared.

skill_approaches.label: Make a quick survey
skill_approaches.information: Attempt a faster survey of the reported remains; failure produces no discovery or XP. No climbing or flight is simulated.

skill_approaches.label: Assess an arcane interpretation
skill_approaches.information: Assess whether an arcane interpretation fits the existing report. This check does not establish that magic is present.

skill_approaches.label: Assess animal behaviour
skill_approaches.information: Assess animal behaviour as one possible explanation for the reported tracks. This does not invent an animal encounter.

options.description: Tier1 energy; 1 points, main action. 3 damage; save negates where listed. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 3; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Thought thrust
options.description: Tier1 mind; 1 points, main action. 3 damage; save negates where listed. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 3; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Force screen
options.description: Tier1 body; 1 points, main action. Temporary HP and defence +3 for three rounds. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 3; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Body renewal
options.description: Tier1 body; 1 points, main action. 3 healing. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 3; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Burst step
options.description: Tier1 insight; 1 points, main action. Stride +2 for two rounds; ordinary movement and opportunity attacks remain authoritative. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 3; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Thought fog
options.description: Tier1 mind; 1 points, main action. Will save or attacks −2 for two rounds. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 3; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Keen mind
options.description: Tier1 insight; 1 points, main action. Initiative +3 and Will +2 for three rounds; no unsupported sight/darkness claims. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 3; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Fellowship
options.description: Tier1 unity; 1 points, main action. Melee attack +2 and Will +2 for three rounds plus temporary HP. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 3; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Electric lance
options.description: Tier2 energy; 3 points, main action. 6 damage; save negates where listed. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 6; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Shared barrier
options.description: Tier2 unity; 3 points, main action. Temporary HP and defence +3 for three rounds. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 6; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Mind lock
options.description: Tier2 mind; 3 points, main action. Will save or immobile for one global round. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 6; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Energy surge
options.description: Tier3 energy; 5 points, main action. 9 damage; save negates where listed. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 9; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Phase guard
options.description: Tier3 body; 5 points, main action. Fire/electric/psychic resistance4 for three rounds. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 9; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Mind crush
options.description: Tier4 mind; 7 points, main action. 12 damage; save negates where listed. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 12; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Restorative weave
options.description: Tier4 body; 7 points, main action. 12 healing. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 12; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Concord
options.description: Tier5 unity; 9 points, main action. Melee attack +2 and Will +2 for three rounds plus temporary HP. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 15; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Astral guardian
options.description: Tier5 unity; 9 points, main action. One sentinel, first legal adjacent tile; owns a turn, expires after 3 + augmentation/2 global rounds. Augmentation +0: longer summon duration. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Synaptic collapse
options.description: Tier6 mind; 11 points, main action. 18 damage; save negates where listed. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 18; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.description: Tier7 energy; 13 points, main action. 21 damage; save negates where listed. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 21; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.description: Tier8 body; 15 points, main action. 24 healing. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 24; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Perfect unity
options.description: Tier9 unity; 17 points, main action. Melee attack +2 and Will +2 for three rounds plus temporary HP. Augmentation +0: effect magnitude 27; secondary damage or temporary HP scales with extra points. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Crystal Shard
options.description: Tier1 energy; main action, 1 points, magnitude4. Direct damage.

options.name: Iron Vigor
options.description: Tier1 body; main action, 1 points, magnitude4. Temporary HP.

options.name: Mental Dampening
options.description: Tier2 mind; main action, 3 points, magnitude8. Will negates weakened; augmentation adds damage.

options.name: Rallying Thought
options.description: Tier2 unity; main action, 3 points, magnitude8. Melee/Will+2 for three rounds, plus temporary HP.

options.name: Adrenal Response
options.description: Tier3 body; main action, 5 points, magnitude12. Stride+2 for two rounds plus temporary HP.

options.name: Synaptic Javelin

options.name: Renewing Concord

options.description: Tier2; main action/3 points, magnitude8. Reflex negates cold damage and slowed.

options.name: Vigilant Link
options.description: Tier2; main action/3 points, magnitude8. Initiative+3/Will+2 and temporary HP.

options.name: Severing Thought
options.description: Tier3; main action/5 points, magnitude12. Remove guarding/psychic screen and apply psychic damage.

options.name: Communal Renewal
options.description: Tier4; main action/7 points, magnitude16. Heal selected ally and adjacent allies; bounded by maximum HP.

options.name: Iron Carapace
options.description: Tier5; main action/9 points, magnitude20. Physical resistance4, stride−1 for3 rounds, plus temporary HP.

options.name: Void Detonation
options.description: Tier7; main action/13 points, magnitude28. Force burst on the selected enemy and adjacent enemies.

options.name: Kinetic shatter
options.description: Tier2; 3 points and a main action. Force damage and remove Warded. Magnitude6; augmentation0. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Shared vigor
options.description: Tier2; 3 points and a main action. Temporary HP and healing. Magnitude6; augmentation0. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Sovereign clarity
options.description: Tier3; 5 points and a main action. Immunity to weakened/confusion plus temporary HP for3 rounds. Magnitude9; augmentation0. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Resonant crush
options.description: Tier3; 5 points and a main action. Fortitude negates physical damage and stride/Reflex pressure. Magnitude9; augmentation0. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Vital exchange
options.description: Tier4; 7 points and a main action. Will negates enemy psychic damage; the caster separately heals4 + augmentation HP. Magnitude12; augmentation0. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Anchoring screen
options.description: Tier4; 7 points and a main action. Physical resistance3, stride−1 for3 rounds and temporary HP. Magnitude12; augmentation0. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Vacuous dread
options.description: Tier5; 9 points and a main action. Will negates initiative−4/saveDC−2 and psychic damage in radius1. Magnitude15; augmentation0. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Harmonic shelter
options.description: Tier5; 9 points and a main action. Recipient maintains radius1 defence/Reflex+2 for3 rounds plus temporary HP. Magnitude15; augmentation0. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Purifying concord
options.description: Tier6; 11 points and a main action. Radius1 cleansing of confusion/lock/weakened plus healing. Magnitude18; augmentation0. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

options.name: Severing tempest
options.description: Tier8; 15 points and a main action. Reflex negates electricity damage and concentration pressure in radius1. Magnitude24; augmentation0. Total expenditure cannot exceed shared manifesting level.

features.name: Mind blade growth 8
features.description: While manifested, melee and projected mind blade damage becomes 2d6. This is weapon growth, not permanent inventory or an additional attack.

features.name: Mind blade growth 16
features.description: While manifested, melee and projected mind blade damage becomes 2d8. This is weapon growth, not permanent inventory or an additional attack.

provenance.origin: Original TRHGD tactical class adaptations; no sourcebook prose or tables copied

features.name: Projected mind blade
features.description: Main action/one focus; manifested blade only. One genuine ranged attack within4 and line of sight; threatened ranged penalty and concealment apply. Blade persists; no second melee strike. Psychic rider only on hit.

provenance.origin: Original TRHGD tactical class adaptations; no sourcebook prose or tables copied

features.name: Pressure stance
features.description: Spend movement, retain main action. Three global round boundaries; replaces every other martial stance, including another class stance. Weapon damage+2 insight, defence−1 insight.

provenance.origin: Original TRHGD tactical class adaptations; no sourcebook prose or tables copied

features.name: Shelter stance
features.description: Spend movement, retain main action. Three global round boundaries; replaces every other martial stance, including another class stance. Defence+2 insight, weapon damage−1 insight.

provenance.origin: Original TRHGD tactical class adaptations; no sourcebook prose or tables copied

features.name: Flow stance
features.description: Spend movement, retain main action. Three global round boundaries; replaces every other martial stance, including another class stance. 20% weapon concealment/stride+1.

provenance.origin: Original TRHGD tactical class adaptations; no sourcebook prose or tables copied

features.name: Cinder stance
features.description: Spend movement, retain main action. Three global round boundaries; replaces every other martial stance, including another class stance. Weapon damage+1 insight.

provenance.origin: Original TRHGD tactical class adaptations; no sourcebook prose or tables copied

features.name: Armed riposte
features.description: Spend movement and one readiness. Until the end of your next activation, your next ordinary incoming melee miss can spend the shared reaction for one melee counterattack. Requires living attacker in reach/LOS. Concealment misses and reaction attacks never trigger; no counter chains. Automatically resolves only when explicitly armed and an ordinary incoming melee attack misses. One shared reaction; arm is consumed even if counter misses.

provenance.origin: Original TRHGD tactical class adaptations; no sourcebook prose or tables copied

features.name: Resolute renewal
features.description: Once at the start of your actual activation, recover one readiness up to capacity. No XP or off-turn recovery; this original bounded adaptation has no random grant deck.

provenance.origin: Original TRHGD tactical class adaptations; no sourcebook prose or tables copied

features.name: Armed afterimage
features.description: Movement/one readiness. A surviving ordinary incoming melee hit may spend your shared reaction to gain50% weapon concealment until next global round. It does not undo the triggering damage. Misses/ranged/reaction hits never trigger. Only after a surviving ordinary melee hit while armed. Shared reaction; protects against later weapon attacks, not the triggering hit or spells.

provenance.origin: Original TRHGD tactical class adaptations; no sourcebook prose or tables copied

features.name: Mindblade echo
features.description: After your ordinary manifested melee hit, spend the shared reaction for half Soulknife level nonstacking temporary HP. Not on ranged, miss, concealment, natural form or reaction attacks. Competes with protection/opportunity.
